members.name: value
members.doc: The picker's color, when the caller controls it. The picker keeps its color in this value's color space.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting color, when the picker controls itself. It also sets the color space the picker keeps its color in.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time a color control inside changes it, in the color space of the value, or of defaultValue when uncontrolled, and in rgba() form with neither. A disabled or read-only picker does not call it.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every Mux UI color control inside the picker, at any depth. A child cannot turn it off, and native elements inside are not affected.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes every Mux UI color control inside the picker read-only, at any depth. A child cannot turn it off, and native elements inside are not affected.
